MWI.note: Document says nothing on civil-servant digital-skills training.
Mentions hub training and bootcamps generally, no national public digital-skills programme or count.
Document does not discuss a national digital strategy.
Says angel and venture capital are scarce; names no amount or deal.

facts.fact: Tech Trends Malawi says that in 2024 Malawi proposed a Digital Innovation and Entrepreneurship Bill for a legal framework for startups, hubs and early-stage investment, but the bill never became law.
Tech Trends Malawi says Malawi has several innovation hubs, some of which run incubation programmes, mHub being an early pioneer, though most depend on donor funding.
